scope: Root independent source review of binary-alpha cell pipeline candidate and hash-bound tests. No new execution, measured benefit or adoption.
findings: Eligibility certifies all LUT values, all animation frames and downscaled twins against current descriptor alpha metadata. Unknown/truncated records, overflowed ranges and non-Alpha blend modes decline.
Guard selects only native zoom1/downscale1/art0/unstacked/unscaled direct4/5 and non-float quantized paths. Internal source and wider modes retain existing pipelines.

Draw geometry, pass order and zero-alpha shader discard remain unchanged. Disabling destination blending for certified opaque-or-discard fragments is consistent with exact output requirements. No CPU pixel rendering, new shader, lock, pass or readback.
Atlas/palette/RGBA descriptor changes refresh the proof. Whole world/LUT/set changes reconstruct it. Existing source runs remain for reversibility.

Tests include independent integer expected pixels with transparent holes and following fog; mutable alpha, future animation/twin, queued control and feature-free cases. Recorded4K fixture adds actual cell layers/art but reconstructed viewport/geometry and omits UI/text/units.
decision: No source blocker found in reviewed candidate. Keep isolated. Prebuilt 4K GPU parity, actualApp equivalence and measured end-to-end benefit remain required before promotion.
limitations: Source review does not establish speedup. Historical unqualified 866 workload cannot supply actualApp acceptance.
Only certified native1x paths benefit; no generalized shader/Metal/performance claim.
